programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Deadly Formula - S3E8. The suspicious circumstances surrounding the death of a 4-month-old infant prompt authorities to arrest, charge and convict the baby's mother, but the true explanation is revealed when she gives birth (11/19/1998)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Beaten by a Hair - S3E9. A peculiar strand of hair found in the victim's brush provides forensic scientists with key evidence in a missing person case regarding a woman who disappeared after leaving her home to walk to the tr (12/03/1998)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Crime Seen - S3E10. DNA evidence supports the determined claims of a man who has maintained his innocence during several years of incarceration after being wrongly convicted and sentenced to three consecutive life terms (12/03/1998)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Speck of Evidence - S3E11. When a young girl fails to return from a trip to the post office, police investigators and forensic scientists examine her recovered and slightly damaged bicycle in an attempt to learn what happened t (01/07/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Broken Bond - S3E12. A 2-year-old boy is admitted to the emergency room after suffering from brain seizures and breathing difficulties, and doctors are unable to come up with a diagnosis until a clue from the boy's sister (01/14/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Out of the Ashes - S3E13. The trail of a girl's disappearance turns up few leads until police decide to interrogate her boyfriend and childhood friend. (01/21/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Invisible Intruder - S4E1. Authorities investigating the death of two young boys and the stabbing of their mother are faced with a horrific crime scene, and careful analysis of the blood evidence suggests that the morbid scene (10/06/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The Killing Room - S4E2. Police investigating a missing person case discover blood evidence in a couple of spots in the victim's apartment, and further analysis with the use of a substance that illuminates the faintest traces (10/13/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Ultimate Betrayal - S4E3. Two out of four family members fail to make it out alive when a mysterious fire engulfs a doctor's house on a windy night in October of 1995, and forensic evidence found among the debris reveals the s (10/20/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cement the Case - S4E4. When a 42-year-old mother of three was found beaten to death, her husband confessed he may have been drunk, blacked out, and killed her. (10/27/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Innocence Lost - S4E5. Melissa Branned disappears and police zero in on a suspect and find blue fibers in his car which they hope will match the outfit the girl was last seen wearing. (11/03/1999)

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: 'Til Death Do Us Part - S4E6. A man dies after being taken to the hospital with strange symptoms and investigators determine he was poisoned; and find traces of the poison in the thermos his wife would bring him while in the hospi (11/10/1999)
